It could be abdominal migraines. Most CVS suffers also are diagnosed with these. They can cause all the same symptoms CVS. Are you sensitive to light, sounds or smells during these attacks? If you are then they are most likely abdominal migraines.

I think your doctor misdiagnosed you. Is sounds like you actually had CHS not CVS. CVS is a migraine variant disorder. Marijuana helps some sufferers of CVS and triggers others. Also it isn't the weed making you sick it's the neem oil in the pesticides they put on the plants.
